visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with light brown hair tied back in a bun stands in a brightly lit room with neutral walls. She wears a cream-colored lace camisole. Her neck is initially visible with some white skin product already applied. She points towards her neck while smiling gently at the camera. (2) She holds up a golden glass skincare bottle and applies clear oil to her neck and chest area, massaging it in thoroughly with her palms. (3) She presents a white cream jar with a gold lid, then uses a small golden spatula to scoop out a large amount of thick white cream. (4) She applies the thick cream generously over her neck and upper chest, demonstrating a 'masking' technique. She points to lines on her neck and explains the process through subtitles. (5) After the application, she smiles at the camera, shows her skin's appearance, and makes a heart shape with her hands. The video ends with a black screen displaying a website URL.
